get_example_data: get example model and input data using get_example_data from torchray.benchmark
get_module: retrieve a named submodule from a PyTorch model using get_module by its path string
Probe: create a Probe on a model layer to capture its output activations and gradients
ExcitationBackpropContext: use ExcitationBackpropContext as a context manager to enable excitation backprop during forward and backward passes
gradient_to_contrastive_excitation_backp: convert a captured gradient tensor into a contrastive excitation backprop saliency map
